author: Andrew Fisher
scope: Independent direct visual review of every supplied desktop and phone still; no GPU/browser launched by reviewer; stills do not establish temporal smoothness or hardware performance.

findings.subject: Road proportions and edge continuity
findings.detail: Desktop and phone road-level sectors show a consistently narrower enclosed road, kerbs beside the barriers, and continuous corner joins. No visible doubled wide boundary or deck holes.

findings.subject: Car and camera clearance
findings.detail: Car remains fully visible in chase/hero captures and separated from walls. Onboard road views remain clear. This is consistent with independent full-lap CPU hull/road-camera evidence.

findings.subject: Retained external anchors and pit structure
findings.detail: No visible tyre stack or brakeboard intrudes into the corrected carriageway in these stills. Some original outside-road decorations are distant or hidden, so their complete placement is not visually established. Pit-side truss/open structure remains visible in final straight captures.

findings.subject: Fence heights and appearance
findings.detail: Existing concrete/fence vertical dimensions are unchanged. Closer barriers now frame the roadway clearly; this review does not establish surveyed race-barrier alignment or exact source heights.

findings.subject: Banner seam overlap
findings.detail: COATES and GC500 2026 panels overlap at approximately 0.77 km. CPU diagnosis confirms the source first/final outer-loop banners were only about 2 m apart; corrected placement makes their planes parallel. A bounded circular-spacing fix is being tested, preserving all artwork dimensions, text and unrelated source geometry.

findings.subject: Remaining illustrative appearance
findings.detail: Road surface, city massing, crowds and foliage remain stylised. Visual improvement does not establish photorealism or a 10/10 quality score.

newSourceOriginals: None copied or published. Private captures remain private.
